summary_md:
# Bäst att lägga ned bolaget

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-06-26  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts start with global markets: Micron's huge report (they call it a bargain at a P/E of about 8, though they worry about competition in 2028-29), Apple's memory-driven price hikes, and the AI-spending doubts that followed. In Sweden, they praise Castellum's SEK 13bn property sale to Wihlborgs, which buys back shares. They are split on whether Wihlborgs' purchase is hybris. They are lukewarm on H&M's sales, call Duni a buyout candidate, note that JM is putting out a stream of new-project releases ahead of its report, and say oil looks too cheap. The overall mood is mixed and cautious.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 CAST — Castellum | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Sold SEK 13bn of property near book value, will buy back shares at ~20% below NAV; hosts love the move and see Akelius as the activist.

#### Reasoning

Host praises the sale close to book value while shares trade about 20% below NAV. Buying back stock at that discount beats buying new property. There are more assets to sell (Entra stake). The market liked it (+3-4%). There is no explicit buy call, but the host is clearly positive.

#### Sell Triggers

- if buyback plan is dropped
- if the discount to NAV closes
- if property values are written down

> *"Jag älskar den här typen av rörelse från Castellum."*

---

### 🟠 WIHL — Wihlborgs | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Hosts split: one backs its Skåne know-how to fill 15% vacancy, the other sees hybris, 59% loan-to-value and a possible share issue.

#### Reasoning

The deal takes on a 5% yield and 15% vacancy, raises loan-to-value to 59% and may need a share issue. Its strong man Erik Paulsson is gone. On the other side, it knows the region best and could turn the properties around. Wihlborgs now has to prove it; worth watching.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a share issue is announced
- if vacancy does not fall
- if loan-to-value rises further

> *"Jag tycker att Wihlborg ska bli intressant att följa"*

---

### ⛔ HM-B — H&M | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Sales stuck while cost cuts lift margins; P/E ~20 with little growth; hosts not positive.

#### Reasoning

One host says H&M is not among Sweden's most interesting stocks: P/E around 20 and growth driven by cost savings. The other has never been positive given competition from Inditex and online players. A short-term boost from Stefan Persson's buying is possible.

#### Sell Triggers

- if sales growth picks up again
- if an external CEO or a spin-off unlocks value

> *"Jag har aldrig varit positiv till H&amp."*

---

### 🟠 DUNI — Duni | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Buyout candidate: under 80 vs Mellby Gård's 2023 bid of 96, has fallen 20%+ like this year's bid targets, and issued a profit warning.

#### Reasoning

Duni fits the pattern of this year's bid targets, which all fell 20% or more first. Mellby Gård has shown it could own all of Duni and did the same with KappAhl. The share is about 20% below the old bid. The business has underdelivered, so a bid is speculative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Mellby Gård says it is not interested
- if profits fall further

> *"Det är absolut en uppköpskandidat på den här nivån."*

---

### 🟠 JM — JM | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Daily releases on new projects before the 10 July report may point to green shoots in housing.

#### Reasoning

Host reads JM's many new-project releases as a possible sign that demand is picking up after a long, weak market. The report on 10 July is the test.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Q2 report shows no pickup in demand

> *"JM byggstartar ju inte hur som helst om man inte känner att det ändå är lite ökad efterfrågan."*

---

### 🟠 MU — Micron | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Looks like a bargain at P/E ~8, but profits may fall in 2028-29 as competition grows.

#### Reasoning

Profit has grown faster than the share price, so the P/E is lower. But the market treats these profits as one-off, and prices could drop when the chip shortage eases.

#### Sell Triggers

- if memory prices fall
- if new competitors add supply

> *"Tittar man på värderingen här och nu framstår Micron som ett fynd."*

---
